instruction: Set VS Code to hide all .git folders from the file tree.

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring VS Code to hide .git directories (git version control) from file explorer. Evaluator checks settings.json for files.exclude pattern **/.git set to true. Uses existing check_json_settings metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches VS Code settings.json from the standard location (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
Metric logic (check_json_settings) correctly loads JSON and verifies expected key-value pairs match actual settings
Expected value is semantically correct: 'files.exclude': {'**/.git': true} is the exact VS Code setting to hide .git folders
Data flow is correct: get_rule returns rules dict, metric accesses expected['expected'] correctly
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the single requirement (hide .git folders) completely
No state timing issues: settings.json persists after user changes, no postconfig needed

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
